independent_construction: Let Z consist of the finite records (s,a,r,s_next), using the finite MDP alphabets; add a fixed stop symbol. Take E_0={s_0} with its point mass and E_n=Z union {stop} for n>=1, all with discrete sigma-algebras. Nonempty S and normalized p imply a nonempty reward alphabet. This is only a coding of the existing trajectory, not an enlargement of its output or a change to p.

At a consistent positive-probability nonterminal history h of length n, recursively evaluate exactly the original instructions from the fixed inputs. They determine theta(h), w(h), I=gamma^n, and current s(h). Only supported sampled actions require score evaluation; fixed positive support ensures their logarithms and derivatives exist. The original admissibility condition ensures all proposed updates on these histories lie in U and W. Set the next-record atom mass to pi_{theta(h)}(a|s(h))*p(s_next,r|s(h),a) for records with this current state; give all other atoms mass zero.

All atom masses are nonnegative and their sum is sum_a pi_{theta(h)}(a|s(h))*sum_{s_next,r}p(s_next,r|s(h),a)=1. Since the target is finite, these masses define a probability measure. On each finite history space every event section is measurable, regardless of how irregular the derivative as a function of an ambient continuous parameter might be. No C1 strengthening, Borel-gradient lemma or independence of successive adaptive parameters is assumed.

After a terminal state use the point mass at stop and keep padding. For inconsistent, previously stopped or zero-probability histories not operationally generated, assign the point mass at stop without evaluating out-of-support logarithms or out-of-domain derivatives. These auxiliary kernel values cannot affect any generated positive-probability prefix. At each finite time the union of zero-probability prefixes is finite and null. These conventions supply pointwise probability kernels on the entire product domain as required by the theorem, rather than asserting kernel properties only almost surely.

Apply the full history-dependent theorem under AC. Its iterated finite-prefix laws give exactly the successive conditional action and transition draws, with theta and w updated at every step as originally written. The assumed almost-sure finite hitting time guarantees the declared return of parameters. Terminal-start returns unchanged inputs. This construction supplies existence/interpretation only: no convergence, unbiasedness or new termination theorem is asserted.
